lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: (The Janitor smirks as soon as he sees you.)

lines.speaker: Janitor
lines.text: Marko’s little friend. I figured you'd show up eventually.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: (He pulls a crumpled paper from beneath his cart.)

lines.speaker: Janitor
lines.text: Friday’s answers, all questions. Spotless copy.

lines.speaker: Janitor
lines.text: 400 денари per subject — friends of Marko get the friendly rate.
